intro.title: Introduction
intro.para: DocBook is a semantic markup language for technical documentation. Originally designed for software documentation, it has evolved into a comprehensive schema suitable for many types of technical and business documentation.

section.title: What is DocBook 5.2?
section.para: DocBook 5.2 is the latest version of the DocBook schema, published by OASIS in 2021. It introduces several important features:

listitem.para: Modular design - The schema is organized into modules that can be combined in various ways
XML Namespace - All elements are in the http://docbook.org/ns/docbook namespace
Schema independence - Available in DTD, W3C XSD, RELAX NG, and NVDL formats
Rich semantic elements - Support for detailed semantic markup including annotations, task elements, and improved glossary support

section.title: Why Validation Matters
section.para: Validation is critical for technical documentation because it:

listitem.para: Ensures consistency - Enforces document structure and content rules
Catches errors early - Identifies issues during the writing process, not after publication
Enables automation - Validation enables automated quality checks in CI/CD pipelines
Improves accessibility - Valid documents work better with assistive technologies
Supports transformation - Many output formats require valid input

section.title: Tiered Validation Approach
section.para: This guide implements a tiered validation approach, where each layer validates a specific aspect of the document:

row.entry: ISO standard validation with expressive patterns
Entity resolution and system ID mapping

section.para: Each layer builds upon the previous, providing increasingly sophisticated validation while maintaining the ability to catch different types of errors.
